extensionDescription.message: Read complete ChatGPT conversations with local highlights and comments, and export PDF or offline HTML.

exportDescription.message: Read complete conversations, save highlights and comments locally, and export HTML or PDF.

sessionHint.message: Private conversations use your ChatGPT login session in this browser. Only the selected branch is read, including all its user and assistant messages from beginning to end.

loadTimeout.message: Page loading timed out. Check your login session and try again.

progressLayout.message: Formatting and creating the question index…

readyOutput.message: Ready to save as HTML or PDF.
